name: manual_f6ff26
claim: Do not pack multiword command arguments into one shell scalar and expand it unquoted; pass arguments directly or use a real argument array.

decisions.notes: A shell function forwarded quoted condition phrases through an unquoted scalar, leaving literal quote characters in the staged memory conditions.

rationale: A shell function forwarded quoted condition phrases through an unquoted scalar, leaving literal quote characters in the staged memory conditions.
